partII.text: Pick Army Training at the Dispatch Officer before each of the first four Part II battles
detail: Floors Lv 34, 35, 37, 39; stats grow from the class a unit is in, so set it first
Ch 6 to 9 joiners (about Lv 15) jump about 19 levels in their Beginner class; Ch 10+ (about Lv 25) about 9
Majide Gladiator (Str 60), Mikaela Hunter (Dex 45), Nydine Ornius Rider on her mount, Peppe Rogue? (Spd 75)

partII.text: Then take the bench exams on free Licenses: Specialty in Ch 1, Advanced from the Lv 35 floor
detail: Ch 1 Nydine Armored Ornius Rider, Mikaela Archer · Ch 2 Majide Brigand; Pugilist at Gauntlet C, Warrior at B
Ch 2: Nydine [[class:Dragoon]], Jasmine [[class:Dreadnought]], Fianna [[class:Troubadour]] if not done
Ch 3: Mikaela [[class:Forest Knight]], Peppe [[class:Ranger]], Jasmine if her ranks lagged

partII.text: Ch 1: take any Part I Advanced exam that slipped first (Seteth, Ninae, Sirocco)
detail: Then Cai [[class:Bardinger]] on a horse (Aegis; Riding, Sword, Spear) and Tialla [[class:Troubadour]] (Song of Courage)
Anything over 5 Advanced Licenses in a chapter moves to the next one

partII.text: Part II side trips, back to the main class once each mastery shows (switching is free)
detail: Ch 2 Peter [[class:Sniper]] · Ch 3 Seteth [[class:Guardian]], Ninae [[class:Bishop]]; Tialla back to Bishop
Ch 4 Ultand and Fianna [[class:Bishop]] (Barrier); Peter back to Charioteer, Ninae and Seteth back once mastered
Ch 5 Cai back to Caladrius for Dagda (low Res) · Ch 6 Ultand to Ovate, Fianna to Troubadour

partII.text: Keep Guzran, Noctula, Nydine and Sirocco in their main class; the other bench units have no slack
detail: Their main class lands in Ch 2 or 3 and its mastery needs the rest of Part II
Part II gives about one level per chapter, so a short stint costs little growth
A slow mastery: stay one more map in the side class, or drop the side trip

partII.text: Ch 12 is your last shop: stock Elixirs and Concoctions, since Part II has no shops or free time
detail: Part II Ch 3 asks for plenty of healing items
Part II has no recruiting between battles either: plan Ch 10 to 12 around that

partII.text: Don't hoard weapons: Part II repairs every weapon each chapter and issues Iron +3 weapons
detail: Use Combat Arts freely in Ch 12, even if weapons break

partII.text: Buy a [[item:Giant's Ring]] the day the Paralogue accessory shop opens (stock changes each chapter)
detail: The video puts the shop Paralogue in Ch 10 on every path except Leda's, without naming it
Likely Anna's Golden Secret here (on Dietrich's path it is Anna's)
Bertrand's and Talimun's also skip Leda's path: check the shops after each of the three

partII.text: Bring fliers: Part II wants 2 or 3. Ch 2's Ranger flees toward the east edge from Turn 4
detail: Send Seteth (Dragoon since Ch 11 or 12) and Nydine (Dragoon in Ch 2) after him

partII.text: Bring the whole army: Part II takes up to 15 units (one source), so the bench fights from Ch 1
detail: Army Training makes a late or unused recruit as useful as a core unit, so bench depth is free
All 12 plus Mikaela, Fianna and Sirocco; six of them spend Part I on the bench
If the cap turns out lower, sit Majide first, then Fianna

partII.text: Keep bonding mounts: Cai's army keeps the Stable in Part II
detail: Riders: Cai, Peter, Fianna, Mikaela, Seteth and Nydine

partII.text: Blessings (video order): Aurora, then Kalla to Lv 3, Smyrnos to Lv 2, then Mars, Jurah, Credna
detail: Put your Temple Row service in that order

extra.text: Pack every unit's Part II kit before Ch 12 ends: main weapon, shield, accessory, mask, at most 6
detail: Only what a unit holds carries in (the game says "equipped"; read it as its own 6 items?)
Each unit's Ch 12 stage lists its kit; everything else waits in storage until Part III
Elixirs for Cai, Guzran, Seteth, Ninae, Jasmine: Temple of Balor and Giant's-Print Fort chests, Megaira 2400G

extra.text: Leave a free slot for the Part II drops
detail: Levin Sword +1 (Creek, Ch 1); Hammer +1 (Ch 1 Warrior: replaces Majide's Hammer)
Cleansing Blade +1 (Ch 2 southeast Ranger: Guzran); Horsekiller Bow +1 (Ch 2 west Ranger: Peter)
Longbow +1 (Ch 5 Golems: replaces Peter's Longbow)

extra.text: At 6/6 a unit has no slot for an issued weapon or drop: Cai, Noctula, Seteth, Ninae, Majide, Jasmine
detail: Use up a consumable first, or let the drop go to a unit with a free slot

extra.text: Check what the side trips banked: Black Magic B (Cai), Attack, Get Back (Guzran), Regroup (Noctula)
detail: An unfinished mastery can still be finished later: switching back is free

extra.text: Part II mounts: tick the Ch 12 missable (every mount in the Stable by 11/27)
Finish all three mentorship unlocks: Caladrius (Cai), Dragoon (Seteth, Nydine), Troubadour (Fianna)
Clear Bertrand's, Talimun's, Anna's and Orchel's Paralogues in Part I
detail: Bertrand's, Talimun's and Orchel's in Part I is the safe choice for their Part III joins

extra.text: Take My Late Sister's Accessory if it appears: without it, no Creek in Part II Ch 2 and no Nathan
detail: Ch 9 subquest: Violet Brooch from Axion Gorge, due 10/15
Sources report it only on Leda's and Dietrich's paths, so it may never show up here

extra.text: Watch every unlocked support conversation at the Inn before Part II
Renown doesn't carry into Part II, so don't grind it
